correctness.rationale: Kurilić's Fact 2.3 proves that m-element subsets with the same intersection with the k-point kernel induce isomorphic structures. Counting only kernel intersections of size at most m gives the partial-binomial upper bound. The unary-singleton construction has kernel exactly the k distinguished points and realizes a distinct isomorphism type for every feasible kernel intersection, proving simultaneous sharpness. Finite enumeration independently replays the construction.
